Big Cartel | DevOps Engineer | Remote | Full time

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our team full time. Big Cartel is dedicated to empowering the independent seller with affordable e-commerce tools. We are a 100% independent, bootstrapped, tight-knit team dedicated to our mission of aiding individuals and small brands in setting up shop and making a living doing what they love. Candidates must be US residents at this time. For more details please check out our job posting here: https://bigcartel.recruitee.com/o/devops-engineer
